sections.approachBody: The platform combines assessment flows, result storage, and access to related materials.
sections.diagnosticsBody: The diagnostics module records the current state through a question flow and returns a structured result.
sections.loopBody: Sign in, complete diagnostics, review the result, and continue to related materials and sections.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.subtitle: State assessment with saved results and history.
diagnostics.description:
16 questions, 7-10 minutes. Progress saves automatically, results show inline.

The assessment covers several state areas and produces a structured summary based on the selected answers.

about.title: About the project
about.methodBody: PULSAR is a digital platform for diagnostics, result tracking, and navigation across related materials. The project combines assessment flows, a user account area, a knowledge base, and administrative tools in a single interface.
about.roleBody1: Psychosomatic and physical diagnostics with saved results.
about.roleBody3: Knowledge base with categories and standalone articles.
about.roleBody4: Administrative tools for users, leads, roles, and content.
